swords_1.verse: Where a silver dragon once kept his hall, a captain with no heartbeat keeps a grudge instead. It lies within reach of that grudge.
swords_1.hint: Argynvostholt, the dragon's ruined manor: in the keeping of the dead knight who commands it.

swords_2.verse: Two brothers: one walked into the dark, the other was put into the ground. Look where the good one sleeps.
swords_2.hint: Castle Ravenloft's crypts, in the tomb of Strahd's murdered younger brother.

swords_3.verse: High where the road climbs over the mountain's shoulder, a pale tower keeps a gate that nobody uses. Its sentries have not blinked in years.
swords_3.hint: The Tsolenka Pass: the guard tower above the mountain road.

swords_4.verse: It lies where a lord counts what he has never needed, buried under coin heaped like snowdrifts.
swords_4.hint: Castle Ravenloft's treasury, under heaps of gold.

swords_5.verse: Follow the howling into the high hills above the cold lake. The wolves keep a mother there who never bore them.
swords_5.hint: The werewolves' den in the hills above Lake Zarovich, at their shrine to Mother Night.

swords_6.verse: Among his honoured dead lies a general whose own men called him a mad hound. It is in his tomb, under him.
swords_6.hint: Castle Ravenloft's catacombs, in the crypt of a general once called the Mad Dog.

swords_7.verse: Climb to where the snow never melts and the air won't fill your lungs. There is a temple there, and a great statue whose sculptor never finished the face. Look at its feet.
swords_7.hint: The Amber Temple, high in the mountains, beside the statue with no face.

swords_8.verse: A seat made for one, in a hall made for the many who were meant to kneel before it.
swords_8.hint: Castle Ravenloft, at the throne in the audience hall.

swords_9.verse: Behind a town's bright banners stands a house where something has gone wrong, and in it a room crowded with small, still faces. Every one of them is hers.
swords_9.hint: Vallaki, the burgomaster's mansion: a locked room full of dolls.

swords_master.verse: It lies in the room where he sleeps the day away, beneath everything, guarded by the oldest dark in the valley.
swords_master.hint: Castle Ravenloft, deepest of all: in Strahd's own tomb.

stars_1.verse: Climb his highest tower until your knees shake, and mind the carvings on the parapet. Not all of them are carvings.
stars_1.hint: Castle Ravenloft, at the top of its highest tower, among the stone guardians.

stars_2.verse: You need not walk far. It has been under my own canvas all along, waiting for the hands the cards would send.
stars_2.hint: Madam Eva's tent at Tser Pool. She kept it for us.

stars_3.verse: In a village the river swallowed, the mud remembers a girl he loved once, and keeps her in stone. Ask the hag who rules the reeds.
stars_3.hint: Berez, the drowned village: at the stone monument to a girl named Marina.

stars_4.verse: The dragon's house has a lamp at its crown that nobody lights any more. Climb to where the light should be.
stars_4.hint: Argynvostholt, at the top of its dark beacon tower.

stars_5.verse: Far up the mountain road a door is cut into the rock, and two great figures the colour of old resin stand on either side of it. It waits just past them.
stars_5.hint: The Amber Temple, past the amber guardians at its doors.

stars_6.verse: A small magician sleeps among the castle's grand dead, remembered by nothing but his name on a stone. What he carried in his hand unlocks what he guards.
stars_6.hint: Castle Ravenloft's catacombs, in the crypt of a minor wizard; his wand is the key.

stars_7.verse: A ringmaster has rolled into the walled town with a painted wagon he lets nobody near. Ask yourself what a showman keeps locked up that he never shows.
stars_7.hint: Vallaki: in the locked carnival wagon of the showman staying at the Blue Water Inn.

stars_8.verse: In his house a lady made of paint and varnish keeps her place above the hearth. She has watched it burn for centuries. Look where she looks.
stars_8.hint: Castle Ravenloft, in the room where a woman's portrait hangs above the fireplace.

stars_9.verse: Where the river ate a village whole, an old woman keeps house on the wreck, singing to the child she raised long ago. Take it from her kitchen.
stars_9.hint: Berez: in the hut of the witch Baba Lysaga.

stars_master.verse: A tower stands in a cold mountain lake, and the mage who built it is long dead. Its door still answers to him, and to the one who served him. Find out who they were.
stars_master.hint: The old wizard's tower on Lake Baratok; his name opens it.

coins_1.verse: Somewhere in his house a famous killer is laid out on a stone slab, with winged stone guardians crouched at his head and his feet. He won't miss it.
coins_1.hint: Castle Ravenloft: a warrior's tomb watched by gargoyles.

coins_2.verse: Above the walled village stands a holy house that has become a kennel for madness. Look in the rooms where the young were once kept.
coins_2.hint: The Abbey of St. Markovia above Krezk, in its old wards.

coins_3.verse: Follow the vines to the house that pressed the valley's last good wine. A bargain was struck there that nobody has paid.
coins_3.hint: The Wizard of Wines winery, in the press house among the vines.

coins_4.verse: Somewhere a barrel that held the best vintage in the valley stands as dry as a skull. Knock on it.
coins_4.hint: The Wizard of Wines: in an emptied cask in the winery's cellars.

coins_5.verse: Down where his wine sleeps in racks, one rack holds no wine. A tradesman was walled in among the bottles, and it is with him.
coins_5.hint: Castle Ravenloft: a dark cellar of bottles that is also somebody's tomb.

coins_6.verse: Among the wagons outside the walled town sits an elf with dusk-dark skin who mourns a sister. He keeps it, and he will trade it for a road into the mountains.
coins_6.hint: The Vistani camp outside Vallaki, with the grieving dusk elf.

coins_7.verse: Go back the way you came, to the village, and dig where the mourners stand. It sleeps under somebody else's name.
coins_7.hint: The churchyard in the village of Barovia, among the graves.

coins_8.verse: It rides in a wagon of my cousins by the lake town, in a chest whose owner has lost a daughter. Bring the girl home, and the lid will open for you.
coins_8.hint: The Vistani camp outside Vallaki, in their chief's locked chest; his missing daughter is the key.

coins_9.verse: Find the hearth in his keep that is always burning, and ask why a dead man needs a fire. Behind it is something he keeps and never spends.
coins_9.hint: Castle Ravenloft: hidden behind a hearth, deep inside the keep.

coins_master.verse: Follow the birds that will not leave his roofs. Where they sleep, a clever hand tucked something bright among the twigs.
coins_master.hint: Castle Ravenloft, among the ravens' nests under its roofs.

glyphs_1.verse: A holy woman's house stands above the walled village, and its brightest symbol hides a hollow. Look behind the light.
glyphs_1.hint: The Abbey of St. Markovia above Krezk, behind its sunburst.

glyphs_2.verse: Where frost lies on the beds of a walled garden, a man of straw stands sentry with a stitched mouth. He holds it closer than any gardener would.
glyphs_2.hint: The abbey garden above Krezk: inside the scarecrow.

glyphs_3.verse: Beyond the last gate in the valley, where the walls keep out everything but snow, there is water that remembers the sun. Wade in.
glyphs_3.hint: Krezk: in the blessed pool beside the shrine of the White Sun.

glyphs_4.verse: Go to the woman who bore him. She sleeps beneath his house, and she has kept this for her son's enemies.
glyphs_4.hint: Castle Ravenloft's catacombs, in the tomb of his mother, Queen Ravenovia.

glyphs_5.verse: West of the vines the old dead are heaped into a hill, and from them grows one tree that drinks wrongly. Those who go there in green worship it. Go anyway.
glyphs_5.hint: Yester Hill, at the foot of the evil tree the druids tend.

glyphs_6.verse: Somewhere in his pits, his old enemies were made into furniture. Sit at their table, and mind the lamp.
glyphs_6.hint: Castle Ravenloft's dungeon, in a hall built of bones.

glyphs_7.verse: A windmill leans on a crag above the road with its sails stopped. Something in it bakes, and something in it cries.
glyphs_7.hint: The old windmill on the Vallaki road that the villagers call the Bonegrinder.

glyphs_8.verse: In the mountain's golden halls, behind a door that glows like honey held to a candle, the gifts of forgotten gods lie heaped up. It is among them.
glyphs_8.hint: The Amber Temple, in a treasure heap beyond its amber doors.

glyphs_9.verse: Behind the walled town's finest door, a widow raises a glass to the castle every night. Her strongbox holds it, and an old enemy's bones keep it company.
glyphs_9.hint: Vallaki: locked away in Lady Wachter's house, beside a set of old bones.

glyphs_master.verse: In his house there is a room built for kneeling, and nobody has knelt there in centuries. Look under the dust of its last prayer.
glyphs_master.hint: Castle Ravenloft, in the ruined chapel.

artifact.where: Vallaki, lodging at the Blue Water Inn as the showman Rictavio
artifact.verse: A ringmaster with a menagerie of one has come to the walled town, laughing too loudly. Under the laugh is a hunter who has buried everyone he ever loved. Earn his trust.
artifact.hint: Rictavio, the loud showman staying at the Blue Water Inn in Vallaki, is more than he seems.

beast.where: The werewolf den in the hills, a prisoner of his own pack
beast.verse: In the den in the hills, one wolf has started to look at his pack the way you look at the castle. When they turn on him, be there.
beast.hint: Emil, a werewolf at odds with his own pack, in their den in the hills above Lake Zarovich.

broken_one.where: A hut on Mount Baratok, above Van Richten's lake
broken_one.verse: Up the mountain lives a mage who has forgotten who he is. What he has not forgotten is how to bring down a sky. Help him find himself.
broken_one.hint: A mad wizard who lives alone in a hut on Mount Baratok.

darklord.verse: No hand reaches for yours. The cards set no friend at your side: you will face him with only what you carry.
darklord.hint: No one. The cards gave us no ally: we will face Strahd alone.
darklord.note: No ally (the adventure's table gives none for this card). Engine need: an empty npc means 'no ally'.

donjon.where: Vallaki, the burgomaster's mansion, shut in the attic
donjon.verse: In the walled town's grandest house, a clever young man has made his attic into a cell and a workshop. Free his mind from that house, and he will lend it to you.
donjon.hint: Victor, the troubled son of Vallaki's burgomaster, shut in the attic of his father's mansion.

executioner.where: The village of Barovia, or already at your side
executioner.verse: You have already shaken his hand. A village measured him against his father and found him short. The cards measure differently.
executioner.hint: Ismark Kolyanovich, Ireena's brother, the one the village calls the Lesser.

ghost.verse: The dragon's house is full of dead knights who have forgotten their oath. One of them still remembers, a little. Find him, and make him remember the rest.
ghost.hint: Sir Godfrey, a dead knight of the dragon's order, at Argynvostholt.

horseman.where: His grave in the churchyard of the village of Barovia; he must first be given back his life
horseman.verse: A man of standing lies cold, and a daughter who was never his by blood still keeps his memory. Give breath back to that body and he will stand with you.
horseman.hint: The late burgomaster Kolyan Indirovich, in the village churchyard, if he can be brought back from the dead.

innocent.where: Bildrath's Mercantile in the village of Barovia
innocent.verse: A gentle giant of a boy sweeps a shop floor for an uncle who doesn't deserve him. He is stronger than anyone has ever told him.
innocent.hint: Parriwimple, the big, gentle shop boy at Bildrath's Mercantile in the village of Barovia.

marionette.where: Somewhere in the towers of Castle Ravenloft
marionette.verse: Something clockwork walks the castle's stairs on its own: a jester with a wound-down smile. It knows every passage in that house, and it is lonely.
marionette.hint: Pidlwick II, a clockwork jester who wanders the towers of Castle Ravenloft.

mists.where: Wandering; lately seen near the Abbey of St. Markovia above Krezk
mists.verse: A hunter of my blood left the wagons to chase what chases us, and the man who taught her. Catch her if you can; lately she has been seen on the road up to the abbey above the walled village.
mists.hint: Ezmerelda, a Vistana monster hunter who never stays put; lately seen near the abbey above Krezk.

raven.verse: Among the vines lives an old man whose family wears feathers by night. He is tired, and proud, and he would like very much to be asked.
raven.hint: Davian Martikov, the old master of the Wizard of Wines winery.

seer.verse: Beside the walled town, among my cousins' wagons, sits an elf who lost his sister and won't stop trying to buy her back. Walk his road with him a little way, and he will walk yours.
seer.hint: Kasimir, a grieving dusk elf at the Vistani camp outside Vallaki.

tempter.where: Somewhere on Lake Zarovich, in danger
tempter.verse: One of our little ones has wandered where she shouldn't, out onto the big water by the walled town. Someone has her who should not. Go quickly.
tempter.hint: Arabelle, a missing Vistani girl, somewhere on Lake Zarovich. There is no time to waste.

artifact.verse: He waits in the room where his family prayed, among the broken pews, under a window that has not let in morning for centuries.
artifact.hint: Strahd will be waiting in the castle's chapel.

beast.verse: He receives you the way a lord receives petitioners: seated high in his great hall, with all the time in the world.
beast.hint: Strahd will be waiting on his throne in the audience hall.

broken_one.verse: He goes down to stand over his brother's coffin, over the man he could never be. He goes there often.
broken_one.hint: Strahd will be waiting at his brother Sergei's tomb.

darklord.verse: He will be in the room where his own coffin lies, deep below, where the night is oldest and he is strongest.
darklord.hint: Strahd will be waiting in his own tomb, at the bottom of the castle.

donjon.verse: Under the castle, past the cells, there is a room furnished with the dead. He likes to entertain there.
donjon.hint: Strahd will be waiting in the hall of bones in the castle's dungeon.

executioner.verse: He stands at the castle's lookout, high over the valley, admiring his property. He will turn around when you arrive.
executioner.hint: Strahd will be waiting on the castle's high balcony overlooking the valley.

ghost.verse: He has gone down to visit the king who made him. Father and son, both of them stone now.
ghost.hint: Strahd will be waiting at his father King Barov's tomb.

horseman.verse: Among the endless crypts below, where his house keeps its dead in rows, he walks between the names.
horseman.hint: Strahd will be waiting in the castle's catacombs.

innocent.verse: He keeps company with the brother he murdered for a woman. He talks to him, sometimes. The brother never answers.
innocent.hint: Strahd will be waiting at his brother Sergei's tomb.

marionette.verse: Climb until you can hear the castle's pulse, a great glass heart that bleeds for him. He will be standing beside it.
marionette.hint: Strahd will be waiting near the beating heart at the top of the castle.

mists.verse: The mist lies over this card; it will not show me. He will be wherever he chooses, and he will choose well.
mists.hint: The cards could not see where Strahd will wait. Anywhere in the castle.
mists.note: No fixed room: Strahd moves through the castle (Phase 6 decides).

raven.verse: He keeps vigil by the queen who bore him, in the cold beneath his house.
raven.hint: Strahd will be waiting at his mother Queen Ravenovia's tomb.

seer.verse: He will be among his books, by a fire that warms nothing, reading old letters he should have burned.
seer.hint: Strahd will be waiting in his study.

tempter.verse: Find the painting of the woman he lost. Behind her lies his hoard, and he will be sitting on it like a dragon, counting what it never bought him.
tempter.hint: Strahd will be waiting above his treasure vault.
